about: The structural gates of the owner's startup-bundle run of 20 November 2026 (schema kui.native.library-sweep.v1, run bd6f4d699a384498895f8990a848ab8e) for the 426 regular games with CD audio of games.json, by its id: what the bundle tool read in each original program on the host. class and now are the tool's own words; first_refusal is the first gate of the combined (virtual VMU and New reader) worker that does not pass, null where all pass. music_only_lease is derived here: an SDK SCI family (sdk_sci_family 0 or more), the SDK heap family (heap 1) and both heap-initializer gates, the gates a lease for CD music alone would need (docs/universal-loader-roadmap.md, CD music in regular games: what is left). Necessary, not sufficient; no console result; no game bytes.
limits: Structural gates and the SCI family finder are necessary, not sufficient: VMU + New still needs a console save, reboot and load.
Rows read only from the uploaded startup files; no game bytes are stored here.
